description: This file defines a utility function 'mergeMockedModule' used for creating mocked versions of modules, typically for testing purposes. It exports an asynchronous function that merges an actual module object with build overrides, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous override functions.

methods.name: export async function mergeMockedModule<TModule extends object>( mergeMockedModule
methods.description: Asynchronously merges an actual module object with override modifications, supporting both Promise and non-Promise override functions.
